rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for a girl who attends school.

example.english: That schoolgirl takes the school bus to school every day.
example.traditional: 嗰位女學生每日都搭校車返學。
example.jyutping: go2 wai6 neoi5 hok6 saang1 mui5 jat6 dou1 daap3 haau6 ce1 faan1 hok6

rows.note: Use this colloquial term when referring casually to a young female student or schoolgirl.

example.traditional: 嗰個學生妹唱歌幾好聽喎！
example.jyutping: go2 go3 hok6 saang1 mui1 coeng3 go1 gei2 hou2 teng1 wo3
